description: Source code for Android-specific string utility functions in the net namespace, including conversions between text encodings and Java strings, normalization, and case conversion.

methods.name: ConvertToJstring
methods.description: Converts text encoded in a specified charset to a Java string.

methods.name: ConvertToNormalizedJstring
methods.description: Converts and normalizes text encoded in a specified charset to a Java string.

methods.name: ConvertToJstringWithSubstitutions
methods.description: Converts text encoded in a specified charset to a Java string, replacing unconvertible characters with U+FFFD.

methods.name: ConvertToUtf8
methods.description: Converts text encoded in a specified charset to UTF-8 string.

methods.name: ConvertToUtf8AndNormalize
methods.description: Converts and normalizes text encoded in a specified charset to UTF-8 string.

methods.name: ConvertToUTF16
methods.description: Converts text encoded in a specified charset to UTF-16 string.

methods.name: ConvertToUTF16WithSubstitutions
methods.description: Converts text encoded in a specified charset to UTF-16 string, replacing unconvertible characters.

methods.name: ToUpper
methods.description: Converts a UTF-16 string to uppercase.
